name: AI Chatbot by Jotform – AI-Powered Customer Service, Lead Generation & Automated Customer Support
author: Jotform

sections.description:
Meet the next generation of WordPress chatbots. Jotform AI Chatbot lets you create powerful chatbots, leading to interactive, AI-driven, personalized support to your customers. These chatbots also guide visitors through forms, and result in more leads. Perfect for e-commerce business owners, event organizers, and anyone wanting to automate customer service—no coding required!

What does the Jotform AI Chatbot do?

The Jotform AI Chatbot plugin enables you to:
– Create and train chatbots: Easily design chatbots tailored to your specific needs. Train them to handle customer queries, guide users through forms, or provide information about your services.
– Seamless embedding: Add your chatbot to any WordPress site with a simple integration—no coding required.
– Interactive conversations: Engage users with personalized, conversational experiences that boost engagement and streamline workflows.

Key features

  • User-friendly interface: Create and manage chatbot with an intuitive interface that doesn’t require technical expertise.
  • AI-powered responses: Utilize advanced natural language processing to deliver accurate and meaningful answers.
  • Customizable design: Match the chatbot’s look and feel to your website’s style.

🚀 How it works

  • Install the plugin: Download the Jotform AI Chatbot for WordPress from the WordPress Plugin Directory and activate it on your site.
  • Connect your Jotform account: Link the plugin to your Jotform account to access all your chatbots.
  • Customize and train: Fine-tune your chatbot’s behavior and responses using Jotform’s training tools.

🤝 If you have any questions or concerns regarding your online forms, chatbots, or our Form Builder, feel free to contact our friendly 24-7 support team anytime.

Why choose Jotform AI Chatbot?

⏱️ Time-saving: Build and deploy chatbots in minutes.
💡 Enhanced user experience: Offer 24/7 assistance to your website visitors.
🔒 Secure and reliable: Powered by Jotform’s robust platform, ensuring the safety and reliability of your data.

Who can benefit from Jotform AI Chatbot?

Jotform AI Chatbot is designed to meet the needs of various users and industries:
🛒 E-commerce store owners: Help shoppers find the perfect products, provide instant support, and handle order tracking to reduce cart abandonment.
📚 Educators and institutions: Assist students with course schedules, answer FAQs, and collect feedback effortlessly.
🎉 Event organizers: Simplify event registration, answer attendee questions, and provide real-time updates.
💬 Customer support teams: Deliver 24/7 assistance to resolve user issues, answer common questions, and escalate complex queries when necessary.

🚀 Start transforming your website today!

  • Whether you’re looking to elevate customer support, drive sales, or simplify workflows, the Jotform AI Chatbot plugin for WordPress is your go-to solution.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide functionality and improve user experience. Below are the details of the external services used:

  1. Jotform AI Platform

    • The plugin connects to Jotform’s servers to enable chatbot creation, training, and deployment. This includes accessing your Jotform account data to retrieve chatbot configurations and training data.
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.jotform.com/privacy/
    • Terms of Use: https://www.jotform.com/terms/

  2. API Usage

    • The plugin makes external API requests on the following domain to enable chatbot-related functionalities:
      https://api.jotform.com
    • Plugin uses API in order to create realtime chatbot agent conversions.

Data Disclosure

The plugin may send the following data to external services:
– Chatbot configurations and training data (sent to Jotform servers).
– User input and interaction data (processed to generate responses).
– IP address and metadata for debugging and analytics purposes.

User Consent

Users are required to accept the Beta Program Terms and Conditions before activating the plugin, ensuring consent for data usage and external communication.
For more information, please review the respective privacy policies and terms linked above.
sections.installation:
👉 Install the plugin now and experience the future of AI!
1. Download repo’s tarball/zip and extract it to your WordPress’s Plugins folder ({wordpress-folder}/wp-content/plugins)
2. Enter your WordPress Administrator panel (http://my-wordpress.url/wp-admin)
3. Activate plugin under Plugins section
4. Go to Jotform AI Chatbot plugin page
5. Accept the Beta Program Tems and Conditions (https://www.jotform.com/jotform-inc-beta-tester-and-confidentiality-agreement/) and click on Let’s start
6. Describe the chatbot you want to create
7. Customize and style your chatbot
8. Add additional knowledge base to your chatbot if you want
9. Select the pages you want the chatbot to appear on and click on Save Changes
10. Voila! Your AI Chatbot is embedded to your website 🙂

For further guidance, have a look at the plugin’s help guide.
